3. list_categories_for_company(company_id: int) -> List[str]

4. get_category_id(category_name: str) -> int | None

5. list_cost_categories() -> List[str]

6. list_fiscal_years() -> List[int]
   Show which fiscal years are represented in the data warehouse.

7. get_fiscal_year_id(year: int) -> int | None

9. get_currency_id(code: str) -> int | None

10. get_capitalized_cost(company_id: int,
                         category_id: int,
                         fiscal_year_id: int,
                         currency_code: str = "USD") -> int | None
